{"id":1909795451,"question_id":3958,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"5 months, 2 weeks","timestamp":1770351617,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"30 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1909795451/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Minimum Removals to Balance Array","memory":"105.1 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic: \n    using ll = long long;\n    int minRemoval(vector<int>& nums, int k) {\n        int n = nums.size();\n        sort(nums.begin() , nums.end());\n\n        int l = 0;\n        int maxlen = 1;\n\n        for(int r = 0; r < n ; r++)\n        {\n            int maxelem = nums[r];\n            if(maxelem > (1LL * k * nums[l])) l++;\n\n            if(maxelem <= (1LL * k * nums[l])) maxlen = max(maxlen , r-l+1); \n        }\n        return n - maxlen;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"minimum-removals-to-balance-array","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1651}
